notes.title: 0.0.4 Update
notes.notes:
English Translation
Hello, this is Habom Studio.

We have addressed several bugs and added voice acting to the characters.
Please refer to the update notes below for further details.

Update Notes

\[Production]

Character voice dubbing has been added, allowing for a richer and more immersive gameplay experience.

Some awkward lines have been revised for improved dialogue flow.

Certain production issues have been corrected.

\[Bug Fixes]

Fixed an issue where BGM would not play correctly when moving to specific sections via the backlog in some scenarios.

We have identified an issue where auto-progress operates abnormally slow and will be addressing it in an upcoming update.

notes.title: 0.0.2 Update + ENG & JP Localization added!
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Habom Studio.

The demo build was updated around 03:57 AM (KST).



Please note that the default language is set to English.  

You can change it in the Settings menu.





Update Notes


\[Language]  
Localization for English and Japanese have been added.


\[Scenario]  
The previous story structure (Prologue → Sae-un → Ji-hye → Yun-ha)  

has been changed as follows:  

After the prologue, you can choose a character route:  

Ji-hye Route - 3 chapters  

Yun-ha Route - 3 chapters  

Sae-un Route - 3 chapters


\[Visuals & Storytelling]  
Some mismatched background assets have been fixed.  

Time and location cues were adjusted to match the new languages.


\[Illustrations]  
1 ECG has been added per playable character in their main scenario.



\[Programming]  

Support for Linux has been discontinued.
